Lane 01 · Shared memory-making

Make the story together.

Two or more people create a memorable moment through cooperation, asymmetry, chaos or ritual—then retain a story, photo or keepsake from it.

Design decision

The browser demo must turn zero-install into a social advantage, not merely a deployment detail.

#1 category benchmark
Shared momentsSecond player freeNative only

It Takes Two

Hazelight Studios / EA Originals · PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch

Co-op-only platform adventure where linked abilities only work when the pair coordinates.

20M+ copies sold by the end of 2024; The Game Awards 2021 Game of the Year. Nintendo Life

It owns the “play this with your partner” recommendation. Friend’s Pass removes the second-player purchase barrier.

Steam · $39.99 list / $11.99 sale through Oct 8

Lane 02 · Character helped by looking

Attention is the verb.

The player studies a face, scene, creature or frame. Progress comes from noticing—not from merely clicking through dialogue.

Design decision

Make one observation alter a later permission or response; otherwise “looking” remains decoration.

#1 direct ancestor
Help by lookingFMV deductionNative only

Sam Barlow / Half Mermaid · PC, Mac, iOS, Android

Search a police interview archive by keyword; read the subject’s face and language to reconstruct the truth.

IGF 2016 Grand Prize and Excellence in Narrative; Very Positive with about 10.3k Steam reviews. Steam

It defined intimacy-through-observation as a complete game, not a supporting mechanic.

$9.99 · no demo found

Lane 03 · Knowledge becomes action

Learning changes the plan.

The durable reward is understanding: a routine, pattern, system or consequence that lets the next attempt unfold differently.

Design decision

Expose one previously impossible action after a learned fact; validate that players recognize why it became available.

#1 closest analog
Knowledge → actionTime loopNative only

The Forgotten City

Modern Storyteller / Dear Villagers · PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch

Interrogate a looping Roman town, learn its routines and secrets, then reroute events to engineer a better run.

Overwhelmingly Positive with roughly 13.5k Steam reviews from a cited tracker; 9/10 from IGN, GameSpot and Game Informer.

A remembered fact explicitly unlocks new dialogue and actions—the lane promise made commercial.

Steam · $24.99 · no demo foundReview tracker

Wave 2 storefront sweep

19 additional knowledge-compounding games, spanning mobile deduction, PC time loops, VR roguelikes and Roblox-scale repetition.

19 new titles
Cross-lane verdict

Zero-install is an opening—not an exclusive edge.

The original 18 benchmarks are native. Wave 2 adds true browser play on Board Game Arena and low-friction, free-to-enter competition inside the Roblox client. Fast entry still matters; now it must beat both mature browser rituals and platform ecosystems on clarity, emotional payoff and replayable learning.

Test 01 · Entry

Two taps to shared play

Hypothesis: a URL can beat Friend’s Pass on time-to-together. Gate: two new players reach the first coordinated action without install or account help.

Test 02 · Payoff

Capture the reveal

Hypothesis: one private input plus a timed reveal creates a retellable moment. Gate: both players can name the same peak moment after the session.

Test 03 · Learning

Make memory actionable

Hypothesis: one noticed fact makes a later move feel earned. Gate: players explain the causal link before the UI explains it.

Open evidence

  • Several Steam review counts come from third-party trackers because store fetches omitted the count header; ratings were corroborated across crawls.
  • Golden Idol’s current iOS / Android full-unlock price was not captured.
  • The reported It Takes Two Switch 2 release was a rumor and is excluded from platforms.
  • Immortality’s PS5 port was not confirmed; only PC, Xbox Series and Netflix mobile are listed.
  • Umurangi Generation’s current Steam review count was not captured; its traction case rests on awards and press scores.
  • Life is Strange’s current mobile pricing was not verified.
  • Epic Games Store could not be swept because a human-verification wall blocked the research route.
  • Nintendo and PlayStation expose no public user-rating layer; those records retain “not shown” rather than substituting a score.
  • Four low-confidence sightings were excluded because price was not captured: Rubber Bandits, Labyrinth City, Sketchy Individuals and The Same Bullet.
  • Overcooked! 2, TOEM and Outer Wilds were removed from Wave 2 because they were already in the working candidate roster.
  • Dixit was excluded after a follow-up check found only Stella – Dixit Universe on Board Game Arena; the initial sighting was not treated as verified.

No competitor matches that filter.

Scope: 18 core benchmarks plus 65 deduplicated Wave 2 titles across Google Play, App Store, Steam, GOG, Nintendo eShop, Meta Quest, itch.io, Board Game Arena, Roblox, PlayStation Store and Xbox. Prices, ratings and availability are a 5–6 October 2026 snapshot, not live inventory. Storefront values remain labeled when a page omitted ratings, price or review counts.
